text: No, not all days were checked in the initial assessment. The first version (v1) of the evidence review found insufficient coverage due to a temporal gap on October 7–8, 2026, where no data was available from any sensor (MODIS, VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, or VIIRS_NOAA21). However, the second version (v2) later confirmed full coverage for all days, and no thermal detections were found for the entire period (October 1–8, 2026). The initial gap was resolved in the updated analysis.
